sources.title: GitHub - moekhalil09/leafcheck-ai: AI-powered plant disease detection ...
sources.snippet: 🍅 LeafCheckAI – Tomato Disease Detection LeafCheckAI is a desktop application that detects tomato leaf diseases using a deep learning model. Users can upload a tomato leaf image and receive a disease prediction with a confidence score.

sources.snippet: The proposed tomato leaf-counting model employs a two-phase hybrid deep learning methodology as shown in Fig. 4, which is intended to tackle the complementary issues of global leaf count estimation and particular leaf structure identification.
